entry_points.text: Xen hypercall entry redirects on the high operation bit, else gathers operation plus six arguments per guest width, records privilege and trace, tries accelerated operations, and on success stores the result and skips the instruction; otherwise it queues a userspace exit.

Xen dispatch for scheduler poll and yield, per-vCPU timer set and stop, global timer with zero as stop, event-channel send and timer expiry. Poll refusal falls to yield; timers need enabled support and self targets; send uses direct or event paths; expiry uses fast delivery with deferral on backpressure.

Halt caps poll time, optionally spin-polls while abort checks pass, blocks in interruptible sleep, updates statistics, adapts the interval and traces. Block marks blocking, notifies architecture layers, sleeps until abort, finalizes and reports scheduling.

SVM run stages guest registers, honors forced exits and vetoes, syncs priority and address-space controls, applies nested and enlightenment fixups, brackets the transition with interrupt and speculation handling, then reloads state, finalizes tracking and delegates to fast handling.

Paging loader installs nested base or shadow root with encryption and identifier handling, warning on narrow identifiers. Init prepares confidential, pause-filter and speculation state; destroy tears down interrupt, confidential and speculation state; backing allocation returns a safe page or null.

LAPIC delivery records the vector with ordering against guest-mode checks. Window enable needs global or virtual flag support, then arms a per-CPU flag once, bumps the VM count and arms notification outside nesting.

exports.text: Reusable x86 helpers for exception requeue, fast halt and invalidate, invalidate and no-op emulation. Requeue needs an empty slot; fast paths check a performance gate and divert to userspace on failure; invalidate only advances.

Low-level SVM transitions for standard and encrypted guests plus a static operations vector. Transitions preserve host state and manage speculation around hardware run with reboot or fault continuations; the vector binds lifecycle, paging, exit, injection, nested, management and interrupt hooks.

hazards.text: Restart checks recorded expiry before cancel with benign false positives and clears pending before re-arming. Guest access failures become claimed fault, allocation failure out-of-memory, oversize, out-of-range and cross-vCPU invalid, while early configuration failures decline for other layers.

Wraparound is unresolved with one identifier covering outer and inner guests. Generic all-CPU flush under enlightened remote use warns and recovers. Direct invalidation avoids nested paging for errata. Narrow identifiers, executable guests with disabled save, missing spill, virtual-masked windows and encrypted single-step are warned or forbidden; flag operations divert faults to spurious handling.

Accelerated subset is gated version query, event-channel send, poll and yield, per-vCPU timer set and stop, and global timer set or stop with zero as stop; others go to userspace. Event descriptor width is four bytes for both widths.

Halt uses halted versus runnable states, interruptible sleep, unblock requests, backpressure indication, two-level priority, absolute hard mode, and poll limits of one fast-path port versus 128 maximum.

invariants.text: Arguments follow guest width with narrow low registers, wide 64-bit registers and split timer deadlines in narrow mode. Only privilege zero accelerates. Timers must target the caller with width-dependent copies; negative or overflow-like deadlines become a short delay.

Poll needs APIC plus send enable, uses native or compat descriptors, stack for single and dynamic for multi, rejects over 128 and out-of-range ports with width-selected pending tests. Clock data needs matching shift and multiplier with sequence-protected sampling. Max poll prefers per-VM override; growth multiplies with floor, shrink divides or zeroes, both traced.

Spinning needs a single task, no pending reschedule and time before the stop, denied when the polling control low bit clears. Abort on runnable, pending timer, signal or unblock. Statistics count attempts, successes, invalid successes, wait time and histograms; success means no schedule.

Exit dispatch is a fixed reason table. Errors count only when both validity bits set. Intercepts map to vendor codes plus early, late or post-memory stages. Irq-off handling forwards machine checks and marks interrupt boundaries; machine-check setup clears reserved high bits.

Pre-run handles migration with generation invalidation, dirty marking and per-CPU allocation plus a confidential path. Clean is all-clean minus always-dirty. VP identifier updates on change in one build and no-ops in the other. Priority sync skips under nesting. Intercept rules gate nested cases. Fixup needs pending runs. Cancel moves injection to exit info. Transitions bracket quiescence. Markers use single-copy stores.

Protection follows host capability. Emulation denies machine-check extended and other-vendor ranges and gates the management base on support and non-encrypted guests. Post-CPUID forces save enable, drops mismatched save-load and delegates secure fixups. Invalidate always exits. Management windows arm start interception when disabled, else rely on return. Init is blocked when the global flag clears. Startup programs selector, base and zeroed pointer with encrypted diversion.

Current-space invalidation purges Hyper-V state then uses hardware flush or retires the generation; current-root also flushes nested when enlightened, all-CPU expects a remote path, and guest dirties a register first. Single-address uses direct invalidation only for shadow paging, otherwise guest-wide with optional full-scope report.

locks.text: Pending tests hold sleepable read plus cache read with interrupts saved, reporting undecided when invalid. Abort checks hold sleepable read. Clock fetch drops the lock to refresh unmapped ranges then reacquires. Port lookup uses RCU read with lifetime under VM synchronization.
Window requests are counted and inert when off. With unrelated inhibits only the count changes under read lock; otherwise the inhibit flips only on zero to one transitions under write lock.
The transition runs with the interrupt flag set while global masking blocks delivery, bracketed by clear before entry and set after exit, with nonmaskable handling around the post-exit window.

state_machines.text: Validated polls publish a port or multi-wait sentinel, set mask bits, test for pending events, then clear poll state, mask and dynamic storage.

Halt spins while abort checks pass, sleeps with possible no-schedule outcome, then adapts: invalid wakeups shrink, long sleeps shrink under nonzero ceilings, short halts grow with headroom, zero ceiling disables, otherwise preserved.

Start translates kvmclock deadlines to monotonic time via clock caches with joint sampling, else kvmclock plus now. It cancels prior timers, clears pending, records expiry, completes immediately when overdue or arms an absolute hard timer. Expiry tries fast two-level delivery, clears on success, else defers with unblock and kick without re-arming.

Exit handling consumes nested exits, reports entry failure, honors fast hints, else dispatches by reason. Completion resets markers, unmasks on progress, clears queued state and demultiplexes NMI, exception, maskable and soft paths. Rewind restores saved addresses per firmware support. Fast selection needs next-address support and rejects nesting. Intercept checks reject unknown kinds and stage mismatches, else materialize exit info.

NMI programs valid events with forwarding skipping bookkeeping, else software masking or virtual pending set once until consumed. IRQ separates soft and external paths, releases AVIC inhibit when empty or nested, then programs events. Allow checks yield blocked, busy or allowed. Management refuses while nested entry pends, while blocked or when configured to exit. Transitions spill outer state with a marker and restore only with support, enablement and validation.
NMI windows use return exits when masked, return immediately for encrypted guests, use start exits when globally disabled, else single-step with trap and resume after saving flags.

structs.text: Control and save state holds exit reason, info words, interrupt and injection info with errors, next address, identifier and translation control, interrupt and virtual NMI state, enlightenment, debug, performance and saved registers. Reason is 32-bit with 64-bit companions; reporting separates valid, error-valid, vector and four types.

Intercept entries pair vendor codes with before-exception, after-exception and after-memory stages plus constructors. The table routes most operations late, control-flow early, and monitor-wait after memory.
The trampoline overwrites the buffer start with the vendor call encoding. Spill assumes save areas start at a fixed offset in the block and host page, enforced at build time.
